segments.text: SINCE my last, which I believe is not yet gone, I have given an order to have Mr. R――――’s children delivered to him or his mother, or whomsoever they shall appoint: and pray lessen the family as much as possible. I wish I had none in the house, but what were proper orphans. The plantation would then suffice for its support, and debts be paid: but we must buy our experience. Troubles seem to beset us here: but we are all secure in GOD, even in a GOD in CHRIST. His gospel flourishes in London. I am just returned from preaching it at Sheerness, Chatham, and in the camp. This afternoon or to-morrow I set off for Scotland. I can only add, that with continual prayers for your temporal and spiritual welfare, I am, dear Mrs. C――――,

Your most affectionate, obliged friend, and
ready servant for CHRIST’s sake,
P. S. My hearty love to all. The LORD be with you! Amen, and Amen!
